short_reading.title: My New House
short_reading.text: We have a new house with a big yard. There is a lawn and a small fence. Our kitchen has an oven and a microwave. My room has a bunk bed, and I sleep on the high bed.

short_reading.title: Tidy Day
short_reading.text: On Sunday, we tidy our house. Dad uses the vacuum cleaner. Mum uses a broom. I put the rubbish in the dustbin.
